meta.title: Add a Participant column (e.g. Freight Charges) for the vendor to fill

plan.title: RFQ participant column editable by vendor

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow used for an RFQ.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Work on the RFQ stage before selecting its template and sheet data.
Apply an RFQ pricing template so the sheet can be configured.
Add a line item to make the RFQ sheet available.
Populate the required RFQ sheet fields before adding the participant column.
Open the column configuration controls.
Choose the Participant column category.
Add the Freight Charges participant column.
Verify the participant column is visible in the buyer's RFQ sheet.
Commit a valid event schedule required for publication.
Add a participating vendor for the vendor-side verification.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the published RFQ pricing sheet as the vendor.
Verify the participant column is present in the vendor's RFQ sheet.
Enter a value in the participant column as the vendor.
Verify the vendor can edit the participant column and the entered value remains visible.
